links.outcome: Fracture-detection AUROC on external validation sets versus internal test data
links.effect: External validation AUROC 0.953 ± 0.016, versus 0.991 (balanced) and 0.990 (unbalanced) on internal datasets; reported as matching the centralized model.
links.quote: External validation yielded an AUROC of 0.953 ± 0.016, matching centralized model performance while maintaining data privacy.

unlisted_practices: Swarm learning (decentralized, blockchain-based) training to preserve data privacy across institutions

screen.reason: Evaluates a decentralized swarm learning imaging model for fracture diagnosis including validation in a prospective cohort aiding 6 clinicians, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
